test_suites.name: HIPAA Compliance Suite
test_suites.description: Automated HIPAA technical safeguard verification for the patient portal

test_suites.name: Patient Data Sync Regression
test_suites.description: Regression tests for the patient records sync service after race condition fix

test_cases.name: PHI fields encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM
test_cases.description: Verify all PHI fields in patient_records table are encrypted using AES-256-GCM. Check key rotation log within 90-day window.

test_cases.name: All PHI access emits audit event
test_cases.description: Every read and write to PHI fields must emit a structured audit event with user identity, timestamp, field accessed, and access justification.

test_cases.name: Concurrent sync writes use optimistic locking
test_cases.description: Two simultaneous updates to the same patient record must not produce stale data. The slower write must receive a conflict error and retry.

test_cases.name: Sync reconciliation corrects stale appointments
test_cases.description: The reconciliation job detects and corrects appointment records that diverged between the portal and scheduling services.
